title: James Webb Telescope traces radio burst 11 billion light-years away — What can this ancient signal reveal about the early universe?
description: Astronomers have detected the most distant Fast Radio Burst ever recorded. Known as FRB 20240304B, this brief flash of radio waves traveled roughly 11 billion light-years to reach Earth. That means the signal was sent when the universe was only three billion years old. This discovery more than doubles the previous distance record for a fast radio burst. It gives scientists an unprecedented look back into deep cosmic history.
